```{r}
x <- read_tsv("~/Downloads/hap1_vs_hap2.1to1.coords", col_names = c("S1","E1" ,"S2","E2","LEN_1","LEN_2","PCT_IDY","LEN_R","LEN_Q","COV_R","COV_Q","REF_TAG","QUERY_TAG"))

make_plot <- function(scaffold){
  queery <- x|>
    filter(REF_TAG == scaffold) |>
    group_by(QUERY_TAG) |>
    summarise(tot = sum(LEN_2))|>
    mutate(prop = tot / sum(tot))|>
    filter(prop > 0.02)|>
    pull(QUERY_TAG)
  ggplot(x|> filter(REF_TAG==scaffold,QUERY_TAG %in% queery),
         aes(x = S1, xend = E1, y = S2, yend = E2 , color = QUERY_TAG))+
    geom_segment(linewidth = 2)+
    theme_tufte()+
    theme(axis.line = element_line(color = "black"))+
    ggtitle(scaffold)
}



scaffolds <- paste0("scaffold_", 1:18)

pdf(
  "~/Downloads/hap1_vs_hap2_scaffolds_1_to_18.pdf",
  width = 10,
  height = 7
)

purrr::walk(scaffolds, \(scaffold) {
  print(make_plot(scaffold))
})

dev.off()
```
